title: Heat kernel on Ricci shrinker metric measure spaces
summary: As a metric measure space possessing positive Bakry-Émery curvature, a Ricci shrinker with potential function $f$ admits a heat kernel $H_f$ under the weighted volume measure $e^{-f}dv$. In this paper, we study $H_f$ systematically and establish a series of fundamental estimates. Moreover, we clarify the equivalence between $H_f$ and the spacetime heat kernel $H(x,t;y,s)$ under Ricci flow induced by a Ricci shrinker.
